title: More With Us Than With Them
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The helper woke and looked outside;
an army stood around!
“Oh no!” he cried. “What will we do?”
Elisha held his ground.

[Chorus]
God’s helpers are around you, love,
though you can’t always see.
You’re never, ever all alone;
God’s strong as strong can be.

[Verse 2]
“Don’t be afraid,” Elisha said,
“God’s helpers are right here.”
He prayed, “Lord, open up his eyes”;
fire horses, far and near!

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; the night is calm,
no need to be afraid.
Heavenly Father’s helpers stand
around you where you’re laid.

[Chorus]
mood: Guarding music. A steady, protective pulse under the voice, like slow hoofbeats far off on the hills, calm rather than urgent. The chorus broadens with quiet confidence, as if the hills themselves are standing watch. By the last verse the pulse slows and lowers to a gentle, even rock, the watch kept and the child unafraid.
